data.name: Summit Rainforest & Golf Resort
data.address: Av Omar Torrijos Herrera, Panamá, Provincia de Panamá, Panama
data.description:
Set on the edge of Camino de Cruses National Park, this polished resort surrounded by rainforest is 21 km from the center of Panama City and 37 km from Tocumen International Airport.
The relaxed rooms feature Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and coffeemakers. Suites add separate living rooms, kitchenettes and whirlpool tubs. Some provide balconies. Room service is available.
A breakfast buffet is available, as is parking. Other amenities include an 18-hole golf course, 3 restaurants and a laid-back cafe/bar with floor-to-ceiling windows, plus 2 outdoor pools (1 for kids), a gazebo and a playground. Bird-watching and nature hikes are offered.
